title: 跨设备比较 · 原理、关联与应用

questions.chapter: 综合比较 · Choosing a workflow
questions.prompt: Which technique–constraint matches are supported by the lectures?

options.text: Local elemental identity rather than only heavy/light contrast — acquire suitable spectroscopy.
Wet, uncoatable insulation requiring finer detail than light microscopy — consider ESEM.
Off-site elemental analysis of an electron-beam-sensitive object — consider EDXRF rather than electron-beam EDS.
A selected buried device feature — consider a site-specific FIB lamella for transmission analysis.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。BSE或ADF的成分相关明暗不能在任意样品中唯一鉴定所有元素，应配合EDS/EELS等。
B：正确。ESEM可兼顾样品附近气体/湿态和电荷中和。选择基于环境与分辨需求，不表示任何样品都不会受电子束影响。
C：正确。STEM教程给出便携、无法用所需真空及电子束敏感等采用EDXRF的理由。
D：正确。选点和透射是两项要求：FIB确保薄片包含目标，后续还须薄到能透电子。

重点词：information requirement（信息需求）；specimen constraint（样品限制）；technique selection（技术选择）
逻辑链：先确定要测形貌、元素还是内部结构 → 再检查真空、透射、制样和损伤限制 → 选择有相应信号且样品能接受的方法。

source.page: SEM PDF pp.45–47; TEM PDF p.21; STEM PDF p.8; Spectroscopy PDF p.14

questions.chapter: 综合比较 · Choosing a workflow
questions.prompt: A rough ceramic contains metal-rich nanoparticles. Which proposed workflow gives information appropriate to each question?

options.text: Use a higher display magnification to convert an SE image into an atomic elemental map.
Use SE for surface morphology and EDS to identify the elemental distribution.
Treat every bright BSE pixel as a unique crystal-lattice index.
Use a suitable thin specimen and diffraction to determine lattice spacing or crystal phase.

questions.explanation:
A：错误。显示放大不会产生原子级探针或逐点元素能谱；原子分辨谱像需合适STEM及谱学信号。
B：正确。SE几何对比与EDS特征X射线分别回答形貌和元素身份，可在同一区域互补而不是相互替代。
C：错误。BSE主要由核散射形成成分相关对比，不能从一个亮度值直接索引晶面。
D：正确。TEM衍射提供晶体学信息；化学分布与晶体结构不是同一问题，准备薄样品仍是前提。

重点词：topography（形貌）；elemental distribution（元素分布）；diffraction（衍射）
逻辑链：不同物理信号承载不同信息 → SE看形貌、能谱辨元素、衍射看晶体结构 → 同一样品可用互补方法回答不同问题。

source.page: SEM PDF p.39; TEM PDF pp.39,54; Spectroscopy PDF pp.14,17

questions.chapter: 综合比较 · Choosing a workflow
questions.prompt: A semiconductor grain boundary needs composition, band-gap and bonding/valence information. Which measurements are justified?

options.text: EDS can map elemental composition, while low-loss EELS can probe a band-gap onset.
Core-loss EELS fine structure can add electronic-state or ionic-valence information.
One BF or HAADF intensity value is a complete replacement for all three spectral measurements.
Spectrum imaging in a suitably corrected STEM can associate these spectra with small scan positions.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。两类谱分别回答元素含量与价带到导带的低能激发；不能把EDS核心线峰位当带隙。
B：正确。核心损失边形与可用空态/局部态密度有关，可补充元素身份之外的化学状态信息。
C：错误。接受角不同的强度信息并不等于完整的元素、带隙和化学态能谱。
D：正确。逐像素谱保留空间—能量关联，小探针和较高可用束流利于局部图，但并非所有单通道强度像都自带这些谱。

重点词：composition（组成）；band gap（带隙）；chemical state（化学状态）
逻辑链：先把问题拆成所需物理量 → EDS对应元素、低损失EELS对应带隙、核心损失EELS补充化学态 → 谱像把信息定位到区域。

source.page: STEM PDF pp.4,41; Spectroscopy PDF pp.48–50

questions.prompt: Two X-ray lines overlap, and their signals also come from adjacent nanoscale regions. Which changes address the different limitations?

options.text: Aberration correction can provide a smaller probe and more useful beam current without automatically changing the EDS detector response.
Higher WDS spectral resolution guarantees a smaller specimen interaction volume.
WDS can improve separation of the line energies, while a smaller useful STEM probe can improve spatial localization.
Once atomic-resolution intensity imaging is possible, all overlapping EDS lines must be resolved.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。球差校正改变电子探针与可用孔径，不会凭此把EDS能量分辨率变成WDS。
B：错误。WDS分光能力不等于改变样品内电子散射体积。
C：正确。分开邻近能量峰属于谱分辨，分开邻近位置属于空间分辨；两者应分别处理。
D：错误。原子尺度空间能力不消除能量谱峰的探测器展宽或重叠。

重点词：spectral resolution（谱分辨率）；spatial resolution（空间分辨率）；interaction volume（相互作用体积）
逻辑链：峰挤在一起是能量分辨问题；区域混在一起是空间定位问题 → 分别改善分光与探针/相互作用条件 → 一个指标提升不能自动修复另一个。

source.page: STEM PDF pp.37,41; Spectroscopy PDF pp.34,37

questions.prompt: Which cautions remain valid when comparing BF, DF, HRTEM and HAADF data?

options.text: Atomic resolution does not remove the need to know detector geometry and specimen structure.
HRTEM intensity can reverse with focus without requiring atoms to change chemical identity.
A strongly scattering region can be dark in BF but bright in a suitably selected DF or ADF signal.
Failure to appear bright in one DF condition does not prove that a crystalline phase is absent.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。HAADF、BF及HRTEM分别依赖不同散射接受或相位条件，解释时仍必须辨认模式与样品结构。
B：正确。相位干涉及离焦引起对比变化，亮暗本身不是元素转变的充分证据。
C：正确。不同模式接受的电子方向不同，不能要求同一区域在所有模式都保持同一明暗。
D：正确。同相不同取向可能不满足被选反射，单个DF像存在选择性。

重点词：detector geometry（探测几何）；diffraction condition（衍射条件）；phase contrast（相位对比）
逻辑链：样品散射电子 → 不同模式选择不同束或让其干涉 → 同一结构可呈不同明暗，不能脱离模式解释亮度。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.47,50–53; STEM PDF pp.29,40

questions.prompt: A high-resolution spectrum shows two elements with unequal peak heights. Which quantitative argument is defensible?

options.text: Apply appropriate corrections before comparing concentrations; better peak separation alone does not make raw heights atomic percentages.
An EELS edge must be fitted as the same symmetric line as EDS before any chemical information is used.
The method with the highest spectral resolution is automatically the best for every element and specimen.
WDS needs no quantification correction because its peaks are narrow.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。荧光产额、吸收、原子序数、几何和束能等都影响强度。ZAF及谱处理不因WDS分峰较好而失去必要性。
B：错误。EELS核心边反映激发至可用空态的能量分布，与离散跃迁X射线峰形不同；强行同形会丢失状态信息。
C：错误。课件还比较成本、处理工作、透射要求和可用损失能区；最高谱分辨不是所有情景的充分选择条件。
D：错误。谱分辨率提高解决重叠，不取消强度的物理响应与定量修正。

重点词：peak intensity（峰强）；matrix correction（基体修正）；concentration（浓度）
逻辑链：不同元素和样品条件产生不同响应 → 峰高不只由含量决定 → 峰分离后仍需谱处理与定量修正。

source.page: Spectroscopy PDF pp.24–26,47,50; STEM PDF pp.2,7

questions.prompt: A low-voltage SE setting gives a good image but misses a required EDS line; increasing count rate produces a sum peak. Which responses are appropriate?

options.text: Check the core-excitation energy: increasing current cannot replace insufficient energy per electron.
Lower beam current to reduce pile-up rather than treating the sum peak as a new element.
Identify a sum peak as a characteristic line whose energy continuously follows the accelerating voltage.
Increase beam energy when needed, while recognizing that a larger interaction volume may worsen spatial localization.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。特征线能否出现取决于单电子能量是否足以激发相关壳层，电子数再多也不能直接替代阈值。
B：正确。求和峰来自同时到达的光子被合并计数，降低通量可减轻；这与调能量消除激发线不是同一操作。
C：错误。求和峰与特征光子叠加有关，而真正特征跃迁能量由元素能级差决定，不随束压连续漂移。
D：正确。激发线系与空间分辨有权衡；更高电压不是只带来好处。

重点词：excitation threshold（激发阈值）；beam current（束流）；pile-up（脉冲堆积）
逻辑链：能量决定能否激发目标跃迁，电子通量影响计数与堆积 → 分别调整束能和束流 → 同时留意空间定位的代价。

source.page: SEM PDF p.37; TEM PDF p.8; Spectroscopy PDF pp.40,42

questions.chapter: 综合比较 · Choosing a workflow
questions.prompt: Which reasoning correctly separates specimen-preparation requirements?

options.text: A site-specific thin lamella can locate a buried feature, whereas ESEM can address an uncoatable wet surface without that conventional thinning workflow.
Gas-ion neutralization in ESEM means that no electron-beam-induced specimen change can occur.
An electron-transparent insulator is automatically conductive.
A thin support and a conductive coating solve the same problem, so either always substitutes for the other.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。应按所问是埋藏透射结构还是湿表面来选制样与环境，不能一律要求所有材料同样干燥镀膜。
B：错误。中和电荷不等于取消束加热、结构损伤或其他照射效应。
C：错误。厚度与电导性质独立，足够薄并不会自动成为金属。
D：错误。电子透明解决透射及散射展宽，导电层解决电荷泄放；二者不可普遍互换。

重点词：electron transparency（电子透明性）；conductivity（导电性）；charge neutralization（电荷中和）
逻辑链：薄样允许透射，导电路径允许电荷泄放，环境气体可中和电荷 → 三个要求针对不同机制 → 制样步骤不能随意互换。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.19–21; SEM PDF pp.23–24,44–47

questions.prompt: Which proposed acquisition has the required signal path described in these lectures?

options.text: Infer an EELS spectrum from one BF total-intensity number at each pixel without measuring energy.
Measure transmitted-electron energy losses with EELS on a suitable TEM/STEM specimen.
Generate the required EDS core excitations with ordinary low-energy STM tunnelling electrons.
Use a conventional bulk-sample SEM reflection detector as an EELS analyser simply by increasing beam current.

questions.explanation:
A：错误。总强度未保留能量维度，不能恢复完整能量损失谱。
B：正确。EELS必须有可透过样品的束电子供能量分析；它与EDS测发射光子的路径不同。
C：错误。STEM教程指出STM电子单个电子能量太低，不能激发EDS所需的高能核心跃迁；会扫描不代表激发能量足够。
D：错误。通量改变不建立透射几何，常规SEM上方反射收集不能因此变成EELS。

重点词：signal path（信号路径）；energy loss（能量损失）；core excitation（核心激发）
逻辑链：先确认被测粒子与能量维度 → 透射电子能损是EELS，发射X射线是EDS → 有扫描能力不等于具备所有谱学路径。

source.page: Spectroscopy PDF p.43; STEM PDF pp.5,9,41

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly separate the diagnoses and controls in electron microscopy?

options.text: Increase displayed magnification to eliminate both charging and astigmatism physically.
Charge accumulation — provide a conductive connection/coating, or suitable ESEM charge-neutralization conditions.
Change magnetic-lens coil current to vary focusing strength, while distinguishing that current from the incident electron flux.
Focus-dependent perpendicular streaks — adjust the stigmator rather than assuming elemental segregation.

questions.explanation:
A：错误。显示变大不改变样品电荷路径或电子光学失准，只可能把伪影放大。
B：正确。这针对样品中的电荷积累；导电泄放或正气体离子中和与磁透镜束形校正是不同机制。
C：正确。线圈电流控制磁场/透镜强度；beam current是每秒入射电子数，二者不能因都称电流就混为一谈。
D：正确。这是像散征象，四极stigmator修正椭圆束。仅改变颜色或成分标注不会修正电子光学。

重点词：charging（充电）；astigmatism（像散）；focusing current（透镜线圈电流）
逻辑链：先区分样品带电与光学束形问题 → 前者提供泄放/中和，后者调stigmator → 不把所有模糊都归为同一原因。

source.page: SEM PDF pp.23,46; STEM PDF pp.16,19–20; TEM PDF p.8

questions.prompt: A wet, insulating surface has features too fine for the available light microscope. Which choices are justified?

options.text: Consider ESEM because it can combine fine surface imaging with a suitable gaseous specimen environment.
Assume that ordinary high-vacuum SEM preparation will always preserve the original wet state.
Use gas-ion charge neutralization as an alternative to a conductive coating when the specimen cannot be coated.
Assume that increasing optical display magnification alone will reveal the unresolved features.

questions.explanation:
A 对：需要细节分辨且要保留合适环境时，ESEM是课件支持的选择。B 错：抽真空和常规制样可能改变湿态。C 对：环境中的正离子可中和负电荷，减少必须镀导电层的要求。D 错：放大已模糊的光学像不能凭空恢复细节。

重点词：wet state（湿态）；ESEM（环境扫描电镜）；resolution limit（分辨限制）
逻辑链：湿态/不能镀膜是样品限制，细节小是分辨需求 → 同时满足两项条件再选设备 → ESEM的环境和电荷机制有明确用途。

questions.prompt: A large heritage object needs portable elemental analysis and should not undergo electron-microscope preparation. Which arguments are appropriate?

options.text: EDXRF may be preferable when portable analysis is needed without placing the object in an electron-microscope vacuum.
EDS and EDXRF must require identical preparation because they can detect the same characteristic lines.
A FIB cut is automatically preferable whenever the goal is elemental information.
Excitation method and specimen constraints remain important even when two methods detect similar emitted radiation.

questions.explanation:
A 对：老师教程列出便携、不能使用所需真空或容易受电子束损伤等采用EDXRF的理由。B 错：相同的特征X射线不表示激发源、几何与制样相同。C 错：若无需透射结构信息，不能无条件把破坏性选点切片当首选。D 对：方法选择要同时看激发方式、信息需求与样品可接受条件。

重点词：EDXRF（能量色散X射线荧光）；excitation source（激发源）；portability（便携性）
逻辑链：可测相似特征线但激发方式不同 → 真空、损伤和便携要求随之不同 → 应按样品限制选择，而非只按信号名称。

questions.prompt: A nanoparticle study asks whether particles share a crystal structure and whether their elemental composition differs. Which measurements answer the appropriate question?

options.text: Use electron diffraction to examine crystallographic information.
Use suitable elemental spectra or maps to examine chemical composition.
Treat the same crystal structure as proof of identical elemental concentrations.
Combine imaging, diffraction and spectroscopy when the structural and chemical questions are separate.

questions.explanation:
A 对：衍射含晶格、晶相与有序性等结构信息。B 对：能谱提供元素相关信息。C 错：结构相同不自动保证成分比例完全相同。D 对：这些手段互补，先明确问题再匹配测量。

重点词：crystal structure（晶体结构）；elemental identity（元素身份）；complementary techniques（互补技术）
逻辑链：晶体排列决定结构信号，元素跃迁决定化学谱 → 两者不是同一物理量 → 需要时联合测量并关联位置。

questions.prompt: Which signal–origin pairs are correct?

options.text: SE — low-energy electrons emitted from the specimen near its surface.
BSE — incident beam electrons scattered back by the specimen.
EDS — characteristic X-ray photons emitted after suitable atomic excitations.
EELS — energy losses of beam electrons transmitted through a suitable specimen.

questions.explanation:
A 对：SE来自样品电子的低能发射，具有近表面敏感性。B 对：BSE原本属于入射束，散射后返回。C 对：EDS测发射光子的能量。D 对：EELS测透射束电子损失的能量；两者不是把同一个探测量换名称。

重点词：emitted electron（发射电子）；backscattered electron（背散射电子）；transmitted electron（透射电子）
逻辑链：先辨认被收集的是样品电子、束电子还是光子 → 再判断信号的形成机制 → 才能推断其适合回答的信息类型。

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly distinguish scattering, interference and spectroscopy?

options.text: Electron diffraction can contain coherent interference information about atomic arrangement.
EELS is restricted to counting elastically scattered electrons without resolving their energy.
Characteristic X-rays and electron-energy losses provide the same measured quantity merely with different detector names.
Backscattered contrast and characteristic X-ray spectra arise from different interactions, so they need not provide identical information.

questions.explanation:
A 对：衍射是相干电子波的干涉，携带排列信息。B 错：EELS要求能量分析，关注束电子能量损失。C 错：X射线光子能量与透射电子损失能量对应不同事件和谱形。D 对：核散射相关对比不等同于原子跃迁发射的元素谱。

重点词：coherent interference（相干干涉）；elastic scattering（弹性散射）；inelastic excitation（非弹性激发）
逻辑链：核散射、波的干涉、能量转移是不同过程 → 对应不同可检测量 → 对比相似不表示物理机制相同。

source.page: SEM pp. 40; TEM pp. 27,28,29; Spectroscopy pp. 18,44,45

questions.prompt: An expected EDS line is weak or missing. Which checks should precede a conclusion that the element is absent?

options.text: Whether the incident electrons can excite the relevant transition.
Whether peak overlap or background makes the line difficult to identify.
Whether absorption and detector response reduce the detected signal.
Whether a visually bright SEM region guarantees that every elemental line must be detected.

questions.explanation:
A 对：激发能量不足会使相关线不出现。B 对：重叠与背景可掩盖弱信号。C 对：吸收、窗口和探测响应都可能减弱检测。D 错：图像亮度不保证每一元素峰必然可见；阴性结果需要先检查方法能力和条件。

重点词：detection（检测）；background（背景）；absorption（吸收）
逻辑链：信号必须先产生、再逃逸、再被探测并从背景中辨认 → 任一环节受限都可导致弱/缺峰 → 不能直接等同于元素不存在。

questions.prompt: Which explanations of a bright feature are physically plausible in the indicated mode?

options.text: An edge gives more escaping secondary electrons in SE imaging.
A heavy-element region produces stronger backscattering in a comparable BSE measurement.
A crystalline region contributes to the selected diffraction beam in DF-TEM.
The brightness changes with focus through phase interference in conventional HRTEM.

questions.explanation:
A 对：边缘增强可来自逃逸几何而非成分。B 对：较强核散射可增加BSE信号。C 对：暗场亮度可与是否满足被选衍射条件有关。D 对：相位干涉对比随离焦变化，不能把这些模式的亮都解释成同一个化学原因。

重点词：escape geometry（逃逸几何）；selected reflection（选定反射）；phase interference（相位干涉）
逻辑链：同样表现为亮 → 先查看检测模式 → 再分别考虑几何、核散射、衍射条件或相位干涉。

questions.prompt: Why is the comparison between DIC and HRTEM useful?

options.text: Both can convert phase differences into intensity contrast through interference.
They must use the same wavelength and the same type of lens.
HRTEM contrast can arise from interference between transmitted and diffracted electron waves.
Their shared interference principle means that specimen preparation and application limits are identical.

questions.explanation:
A 对：老师Tutorial要求抓住相位差经干涉变成强度差的共同链条。B 错：一个使用光，一个使用电子，装置不同。C 对：HRTEM让不同电子束干涉形成相位对比。D 错：共同原理不取消透射、厚度和环境等条件差异。

重点词：phase difference（相位差）；interference（干涉）；intensity contrast（强度对比）
逻辑链：样品造成相位差 → 波相互干涉 → 强度发生差异；共通的逻辑不等于相同的设备或适用范围。

questions.prompt: What is gained by recording a spectrum at each scan position instead of only one detector intensity?

options.text: Stored spectra can be used to extract different chemical information while preserving spatial location.
A total-intensity image can always recover an unrecorded spectrum after acquisition.
Different spectral regions can answer different questions, such as elemental distribution or low-loss electronic information.
Recording spectra removes the need to distinguish spatial resolution from spectral resolution.

questions.explanation:
A 对：逐点能谱同时保存位置和能量维度。B 错：未记录的能量信息不能从一个总强度值普遍恢复。C 对：谱的不同区域与物理过程关联，能提取不同信息。D 错：能否分开位置与能否分开能量仍是两个独立限制。

重点词：spectrum imaging（谱像）；energy dimension（能量维度）；spatial association（空间关联）
逻辑链：每点保存完整能谱 → 可按谱区选择所需信号 → 得到相应信息的空间分布，而非只有一幅总强度图。

questions.prompt: Which control–effect matches are correct?

options.text: Reducing the scanned area can increase displayed SEM magnification without necessarily shrinking the physical probe.
Improving electron optics can improve probe localization without automatically improving an X-ray detector’s energy resolution.
Increasing electron flux can improve counting statistics but cannot replace insufficient excitation energy per electron.
Increasing displayed magnification alone corrects lens aberrations and separates overlapping spectral peaks.

questions.explanation:
A 对：扫描区域与显示放大有关，但不必改变真实探针尺寸。B 对：探针空间能力与探测器谱分辨应区分。C 对：电子数与单电子能量是不同控制量。D 错：显示缩放不改变透镜物理和能谱峰形。

重点词：magnification（放大倍数）；probe size（探针尺寸）；counting statistics（计数统计）
逻辑链：先判断限制发生在空间、能量还是统计维度 → 调整对应物理控制 → 不把更大显示图像或更多电子当万能改善。

questions.prompt: EDS, WDS and EELS can all respond to core excitation. Which comparisons are correct?

options.text: EDS and WDS can detect the same characteristic X-rays while resolving nearby lines differently.
Improving WDS line separation makes its measured quantity identical to a transmitted-electron energy-loss spectrum.
An EELS ionization edge can have a different shape because it samples excitation into available electronic states.
A shared initial core excitation requires every detector to record the same symmetric spectral feature.

questions.explanation:
A 对：EDS/WDS检测特征X射线，分光方式和谱分辨能力不同。B 错：分峰改善不把光子谱变成电子能损谱。C 对：EELS涉及电子进入可用空态，边形可含电子态信息。D 错：相同初始激发可以对应不同后续被测过程，老师Tutorial要求解释的正是这一差别。

重点词：characteristic line（特征线）；energy loss（能量损失）；available states（可用态）
逻辑链：相同核心激发 → 区分随后测发射光子还是束电子能损 → 再解释谱形及信息，不能只按共同起点类比所有结果。

questions.prompt: DIC and HRTEM share phase-contrast logic, but a thin interface is buried under another layer. Which arguments guide method selection?

options.text: The common interference principle guarantees that the two instruments can examine the same geometry without different preparation.
A suitable cross-section can make the buried interface accessible to transmission imaging.
HRTEM can provide fine structural detail when a suitable electron-transparent specimen contains the interface.
An elemental spectrum alone necessarily provides the geometric thickness of the buried interface.

questions.explanation:
A 错：共通的相位—干涉原理不等于相同信号路径和制样要求。B 对：老师的埋藏氧化层Tutorial关键是让截面包含目标界面。C 对：足够薄且包含目标的样品配合HRTEM可回答细结构问题。D 错：元素信息与界面几何厚度并非同一物理量。

重点词：buried interface（埋藏界面）；cross-section（截面）；phase contrast（相位对比）
逻辑链：先定位目标界面及所需信息 → 选择能暴露目标的几何与制样 → 再利用相位对比获得结构，而非只凭共同原理选设备。

questions.prompt: A specimen changes during repeated electron-microscope observations. Which interpretations remain valid across the lecture examples?

options.text: A time sequence automatically proves that the beam has no influence on the observed process.
ESEM charge neutralization prevents every possible type of beam-induced change.
A change in morphology or diffraction can require checking whether irradiation altered the specimen.
Beam-induced deposition, damage or loss of crystalline order can affect what is measured.

questions.explanation:
A 错：连续观察本身也意味着持续照射，不能自动排除测量干扰。B 错：中和电荷只处理一个机制，不取消加热、损伤或束致反应。C 对：SEM伪影、ESEM反应序列与TEM照射非晶化都提醒要检查测量是否改变样品。D 对：这些变化会影响后续图像或结构判断，不应不加区分地当作初始状态。

重点词：irradiation（照射）；beam-induced change（束致变化）；initial state（初始状态）
逻辑链：重复测量同时带来电子照射 → 可能改变表面、化学过程或有序性 → 解释动态前先区分原有过程与束引入的变化。

questions.prompt: A non-conductive specimen is coated before SEM-EDS analysis. Which considerations follow from the preparation and spectroscopy principles?

options.text: The coating may help provide a conductive path and reduce charging.
The coating is material exposed to the beam and may contribute characteristic X-ray signals of its own.
Preventing charging makes all detected characteristic lines originate only from the original specimen.
Coating choice and the desired chemical information should be considered together.

questions.explanation:
A 对：合适导电层与接地路径有助于电荷泄放。B 对：由镀层作为样品表面材料以及EDS原子激发发射原理联合推得，镀层也可能贡献信号；不是只要仪器稳定便能忽略。C 错：解决充电不等于排除了镀层或其他材料的化学贡献。D 对：制样满足成像条件的同时，也要考虑它是否影响待回答的化学问题。

重点词：conductive coating（导电镀层）；characteristic X-ray（特征X射线）；signal contribution（信号贡献）
逻辑链：为抑制充电而加入导电材料 → 新材料也处于电子束作用下 → 解释元素谱时必须同时考虑原样品与制样引入的贡献。
